Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! A two-day dive trip in the Rosario Islands is a wonderful way to explore the reefs. Since you’ll be departing from Cartagena, the *4-dive package over two days* may fit your plan: it includes four daytime dives, boat transport from Cartagena and lunch on day one. You’ll need to stay *one night on the islands*; accommodation and day-two lunch aren’t included.

The boat departs from *Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.* on day one. The speedboat ride takes about an hour. Ground transport to the dock isn’t included, so you’ll need to arrange your own way there. On day two, the return boat leaves the islands at about 3:00 p.m., with arrival in Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. That means leaving the islands on the morning of the 15th wouldn’t match this package’s return schedule.

Please bring your *diving certification card*. Diving equipment is included. You’ll also need to allow at least *18 hours after your last dive before flying*. Accommodation must be booked separately; our dive base is at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, and other nearby hotels with boat access are also options.

The online price is *316 USD* (regular price *351 USD*). Availability for April 13–14 needs to be checked through the booking calendar or with the team. You can see the package details here: https://divingplanet.org/tours-buceo-snorkel-cartagena/
